2abc6b757313f2b4c868fa2c960b7a06d7cab880.summary: KSI Digital analysed 'Ancient', a Linux IoT botnet with a custom ANCT C2 protocol, captured in a Telnet/SSH honeypot in October 2026. Devices are infected via Telnet logins and fetch a shell dropper in three versions that adds cron and init persistence. The C2 lookup is hidden inside DNS-over-TLS, and the bot stays idle while traced. A 10-minute controlled contact confirmed the C2 live. The report also covers a Mirai kit delivered from the same loader routine, and publishes indicators and detection rules.

2a4321fdcddd7640c9c4c60ed54d73d030eaefe5.summary: Describes North Korean-aligned actors targeting macOS and their RustBucket and KandyKorn campaigns. The report finds RustBucket SwiftLoader droppers now delivering KandyKorn RAT payloads. The KandyKorn chain starts with social engineering over Discord, using a fake cryptocurrency arbitrage bot, and ends with a backdoor RAT loaded in memory. It also links ObjCShellz to SwiftLoader and reports shared infrastructure. Indicators (hashes, IP addresses, file paths) are listed by the vendor.

2a04fb97ff89595bc49dd71a7246402e3b355cc6.summary: Yoroi Z-LAB reports on ATMitch, an ATM malware sample spotted in early April and possibly active since 2017. A loader injects a DLL into the Wincor Nixdorf fwmain32.exe process using thread hijacking. The DLL uses the XFS banking interface to read commands from a file and dispense cash. The report says it is manually installed on ATMs after a network intrusion, possibly used by the Carbanak or GCMAN groups, and may be the tip of a larger attack.
